Title: Successful new user registration with all required fields
Preconditions: User is not logged in. User does not have an existing account.
Steps: 1. Navigate to the Login/Register page. 2. Enter a valid Name, Email, and Password in the Sign Up form. 3. Click Sign Up button. 4. Fill in all account information fields (Title, Name, Email, DOB, Address, Country, State, City, Zipcode, Mobile). 5. Select newsletter subscription preference. 6. Select special offers preference. 7. Click Create Account.
Expected Result: Account Created! message displays. User is automatically logged in. Username appears in navigation header.

Title: Successful login with valid credentials
Preconditions: User has an existing registered account. User is not logged in.
Steps: 1. Navigate to the Login/Register page. 2. Enter valid email and password in the Login form. 3. Click Login button.
Expected Result: User is redirected to the homepage. Username displays in the navigation header.

Title: Successful logout from navigation header
Preconditions: User is logged in.
Steps: 1. Click Logout in the navigation header.
Expected Result: User is redirected to the Login page. Username no longer displays in navigation header.

Title: Login with invalid password
Preconditions: User has an existing registered account. User is not logged in.
Steps: 1. Navigate to the Login/Register page. 2. Enter valid email and incorrect password. 3. Click Login button.
Expected Result: Error message displays: Your email or password is incorrect. User remains on Login page.

Title: Login with unregistered email address
Preconditions: User is not logged in. Email address does not exist in the system.
Steps: 1. Navigate to the Login/Register page. 2. Enter an email address that has not been registered. 3. Enter any password. 4. Click Login button.
Expected Result: Error message displays: Your email or password is incorrect. User remains on Login page.

Title: Login with empty email field
Preconditions: User is not logged in.
Steps: 1. Navigate to the Login/Register page. 2. Leave email field empty. 3. Enter any password. 4. Click Login button.
Expected Result: PENDING PM CLARIFICATION — Spec does not define error message or behavior for empty email on login. Expected: form validation prevents submission and indicates required field.

Title: Login with empty password field
Preconditions: User is not logged in.
Steps: 1. Navigate to the Login/Register page. 2. Enter a valid registered email. 3. Leave password field empty. 4. Click Login button.
Expected Result: PENDING PM CLARIFICATION — Spec does not define error message or behavior for empty password on login. Expected: form validation prevents submission and indicates required field.

Title: Registration with missing required Name field
Preconditions: User is not logged in. User does not have an existing account.
Steps: 1. Navigate to the Login/Register page. 2. Leave Name field empty. 3. Enter valid Email and Password. 4. Click Sign Up button.
Expected Result: PENDING PM CLARIFICATION — Spec does not define validation behavior for missing Name on Sign Up form. Expected: form prevents submission and flags required field.

Title: Registration with missing required Email field
Preconditions: User is not logged in.
Steps: 1. Navigate to the Login/Register page. 2. Enter valid Name. 3. Leave Email field empty. 4. Enter Password. 5. Click Sign Up button.
Expected Result: PENDING PM CLARIFICATION — Spec does not define validation behavior for missing Email on Sign Up form. Expected: form prevents submission and flags required field.

Title: Registration with already registered email address
Preconditions: User is not logged in. Email address is already registered in the system.
Steps: 1. Navigate to the Login/Register page. 2. Enter a Name and an email address that already exists in the system. 3. Enter a Password. 4. Click Sign Up button.
Expected Result: PENDING PM CLARIFICATION — Spec does not define the error message for duplicate email registration. Expected: error message indicates email is already registered.

Title: Registration — verify username displays in nav after account creation
Preconditions: User is not logged in. User does not have an existing account.
Steps: 1. Complete full registration flow with valid data. 2. Click Create Account. 3. Observe navigation header after Account Created message.
Expected Result: Username entered during registration displays in the navigation header confirming automatic login.

Title: Registration with missing account information fields on step 2
Preconditions: User has completed Sign Up form and reached account information page.
Steps: 1. Leave required account information fields empty (Address, City, State, Zipcode, Mobile, Country). 2. Click Create Account.
Expected Result: PENDING PM CLARIFICATION — Spec does not define which fields on account information page are required vs optional. Expected: form prevents submission and flags required fields.

Title: Login with correct email — wrong case sensitivity
Preconditions: User has a registered account with a lowercase email address.
Steps: 1. Navigate to Login/Register page. 2. Enter the registered email in all uppercase. 3. Enter correct password. 4. Click Login.
Expected Result: PENDING PM CLARIFICATION — Spec does not define whether email login is case sensitive. Expected: login succeeds as email fields are typically case insensitive.

Title: Verify Login and Sign Up forms are both present on the same page
Preconditions: User is not logged in.
Steps: 1. Navigate to the Login/Register page. 2. Observe page layout.
Expected Result: Two separate forms are visible on the same page — Login form on one side and Sign Up form on the other.

Title: Registration — newsletter and special offers preferences are selectable
Preconditions: User is on the account information page during registration.
Steps: 1. Locate newsletter subscription option. 2. Select a preference. 3. Locate special offers option. 4. Select a preference.
Expected Result: Both preferences can be selected independently. Selection is reflected before clicking Create Account.

Title: Verify logged-in user cannot see Login/Register page content
Preconditions: User is logged in.
Steps: 1. Attempt to navigate directly to the Login/Register page URL while logged in.
Expected Result: PENDING PM CLARIFICATION — Spec does not define behavior when a logged-in user navigates to the login page. Expected: user is redirected to homepage or login form is hidden.

Title: Registration with invalid email format
Preconditions: User is not logged in.
Steps: 1. Navigate to Login/Register page. 2. Enter a valid Name. 3. Enter an invalid email format (e.g. notanemail or user@ or @domain.com). 4. Enter a Password. 5. Click Sign Up.
Expected Result: PENDING PM CLARIFICATION — Spec does not define email format validation behavior. Expected: form prevents submission and indicates invalid email format.

Title: Registration — Title field accepts Mr and Mrs options only
Preconditions: User is on account information page during registration.
Steps: 1. Click on the Title field. 2. Observe available options.
Expected Result: Title field displays exactly two options: Mr and Mrs. No other values are selectable.

Title: Logout and verify session is cleared — cannot access account without logging in again
Preconditions: User is logged in.
Steps: 1. Click Logout in navigation header. 2. Attempt to navigate to account or order history page directly via URL.
Expected Result: PENDING PM CLARIFICATION — Spec does not define behavior for accessing protected pages after logout. Expected: user is redirected to Login page and cannot access account content without re-authenticating.

Title: Login with valid credentials — verify redirect to homepage
Preconditions: User has a registered account. User is not logged in.
Steps: 1. Navigate to Login/Register page. 2. Enter valid email and password. 3. Click Login button. 4. Observe URL and page content after login.
Expected Result: User is redirected to the ShopSmart homepage. Username is visible in the navigation header.

Title: Verify featured products display on homepage
Preconditions: User is on the ShopSmart homepage. User may be logged in or logged out.
Steps: 1. Navigate to the ShopSmart homepage. 2. Observe the product section on the page.
Expected Result: Featured products display with image, name, and price for each product.

Title: Verify all products display on the All Products page
Preconditions: User is on the ShopSmart homepage.
Steps: 1. Navigate to the All Products page. 2. Observe the product listing.
Expected Result: Full product catalog displays. Each product shows image, name, and price.

Title: Filter products by Women category
Preconditions: User is on the All Products page.
Steps: 1. Locate the category sidebar on the left. 2. Click on the Women category.
Expected Result: Product listing updates to show only Women's products. Non-Women products are no longer visible.

Title: Filter products by subcategory within Women category
Preconditions: User is on the All Products page.
Steps: 1. Click on the Women category in the left sidebar. 2. Click on a subcategory under Women (e.g. Dress, Tops, Saree).
Expected Result: Product listing updates to show only products matching the selected subcategory. Products from other subcategories are not shown.

Title: Filter products by Men category
Preconditions: User is on the All Products page.
Steps: 1. Locate the category sidebar on the left. 2. Click on the Men category.
Expected Result: Product listing updates to show only Men's products.

Title: Filter products by Kids category
Preconditions: User is on the All Products page.
Steps: 1. Locate the category sidebar on the left. 2. Click on the Kids category.
Expected Result: Product listing updates to show only Kids products.

Title: Filter products by brand
Preconditions: User is on the All Products page.
Steps: 1. Locate the brand filter in the left sidebar. 2. Click on any brand name.
Expected Result: Product listing updates to show only products matching the selected brand.

Title: View product detail page from product listing
Preconditions: User is on the All Products page.
Steps: 1. Click on any product from the listing. 2. Observe the product detail page.
Expected Result: Product detail page displays: image, name, category, price, availability, condition, and brand.

Title: Update quantity on product detail page before adding to cart
Preconditions: User is on a product detail page.
Steps: 1. Locate the quantity field on the product detail page. 2. Change the quantity to 3. 3. Observe the quantity field.
Expected Result: Quantity field updates to reflect the value entered. Add to Cart button is available.

Title: Submit a product review with all required fields
Preconditions: User is on a product detail page.
Steps: 1. Scroll to the Write Your Review section. 2. Enter a valid Name. 3. Enter a valid Email. 4. Enter review text. 5. Click Submit.
Expected Result: PENDING PM CLARIFICATION — Spec does not define the success message or behavior after review submission. Expected: confirmation message displays indicating review was submitted successfully.

Title: Submit product review with missing Name field
Preconditions: User is on a product detail page.
Steps: 1. Scroll to the Write Your Review section. 2. Leave Name field empty. 3. Enter valid Email and review text. 4. Click Submit.
Expected Result: PENDING PM CLARIFICATION — Spec does not define validation behavior for missing Name in review form. Expected: form prevents submission and flags Name as required.

Title: Submit product review with invalid email format
Preconditions: User is on a product detail page.
Steps: 1. Scroll to the Write Your Review section. 2. Enter a valid Name. 3. Enter an invalid email format (e.g. notanemail). 4. Enter review text. 5. Click Submit.
Expected Result: PENDING PM CLARIFICATION — Spec does not define email validation behavior on review form. Expected: form prevents submission and indicates invalid email format.

Title: Search for a product that exists — verify results match search term across full catalog
Preconditions: User is on the All Products page. No category filter is active.
Steps: 1. Locate the search bar on the Products page. 2. Ensure no category is selected in the left sidebar. 3. Enter a valid product name or keyword. 4. Click the Search button. 5. Observe the search results.
Expected Result: Search results page displays all products across all categories that match the search term. Each result shows product image, name, and price.

Title: Search for a product that does not exist
Preconditions: User is on the All Products page.
Steps: 1. Locate the search bar on the Products page. 2. Enter a search term that does not match any product (e.g. zzzznotaproduct). 3. Click the Search button.
Expected Result: Empty results page displays. PENDING PM CLARIFICATION — Spec does not define the empty state message. Expected: a message indicates no products were found matching the search term.

Title: Search with empty search field
Preconditions: User is on the All Products page.
Steps: 1. Locate the search bar on the Products page. 2. Leave the search field empty. 3. Click the Search button.
Expected Result: PENDING PM CLARIFICATION — Spec does not define behavior for submitting an empty search. Expected: either all products display or a validation message prompts the user to enter a search term.

Title: Search within an active category filter returns only results from that category (SMART-201)
Preconditions: User is on the All Products page.
Steps: 1. Click on Women category in the left sidebar. 2. Click on the Dress subcategory. 3. Verify product listing shows only Women's Dresses. 4. Enter a search term in the search bar (e.g. blue). 5. Click the Search button. 6. Observe the search results.
Expected Result: Search results display only products matching the search term within the Women > Dress category. Products from Men, Kids, or other Women subcategories are not included in results.

Title: Clearing category filter after search returns results from all categories (SMART-201)
Preconditions: User is on the All Products page. A category filter is active.
Steps: 1. Select Women > Dress from the left sidebar. 2. Enter a search term in the search bar. 3. Click Search. 4. Verify results are scoped to Women > Dress. 5. Clear the category filter by clicking on another category or deselecting. 6. Search again using the same search term. 7. Observe the results.
Expected Result: After clearing the category filter, search results return matching products from all categories — not scoped to the previously selected category.

Title: Search within Men category returns only Men's products matching search term (SMART-201)
Preconditions: User is on the All Products page.
Steps: 1. Click on the Men category in the left sidebar. 2. Enter a search term in the search bar. 3. Click the Search button. 4. Observe the search results.
Expected Result: Search results display only products matching the search term within the Men category. Women's and Kids' products are not included in the results.

Title: Add product to cart from product listing page
Preconditions: User is on the All Products page. At least one product is available.
Steps: 1. Hover over any product on the listing page. 2. Click the Add to Cart button that appears. 3. Observe the confirmation modal.
Expected Result: Confirmation modal displays with two options: Continue Shopping and View Cart.

Title: Add product to cart from product detail page
Preconditions: User is on a product detail page.
Steps: 1. Click the Add to Cart button on the product detail page. 2. Observe the confirmation modal.
Expected Result: Confirmation modal displays with two options: Continue Shopping and View Cart.

Title: Continue Shopping from confirmation modal returns user to previous page
Preconditions: User has added a product to cart from the product listing page and the confirmation modal is displayed.
Steps: 1. Click Continue Shopping in the confirmation modal. 2. Observe the page the user lands on.
Expected Result: User is returned to the exact product listing page they were on before adding to cart — not the homepage.

Title: View Cart from confirmation modal navigates to cart page
Preconditions: User has added a product to cart and the confirmation modal is displayed.
Steps: 1. Click View Cart in the confirmation modal. 2. Observe the page the user lands on.
Expected Result: User is taken to the Shopping Cart page. The added product is visible in the cart.

Title: Cart displays correct item details for each product
Preconditions: User has at least one item in the cart.
Steps: 1. Navigate to the Shopping Cart page. 2. Observe each item in the cart.
Expected Result: Each cart item displays: image, name, price, quantity, and total for that item.

Title: Update product quantity directly on cart page
Preconditions: User has at least one item in the cart. User is on the Shopping Cart page.
Steps: 1. Locate the quantity field for any item in the cart. 2. Change the quantity to a new valid value. 3. Observe the item total and cart subtotal.
Expected Result: Item total updates immediately to reflect the new quantity. Cart subtotal updates immediately.

Title: Remove individual item from cart using X button
Preconditions: User has at least two items in the cart. User is on the Shopping Cart page.
Steps: 1. Click the X button next to any item in the cart. 2. Observe the cart contents.
Expected Result: The selected item is removed from the cart. Remaining items are still displayed. Cart subtotal updates to reflect the removal.

Title: Empty cart state displays message and continue shopping button
Preconditions: User is on the Shopping Cart page with no items in the cart.
Steps: 1. Navigate to the Shopping Cart page with an empty cart. 2. Observe the page content.
Expected Result: PENDING PM CLARIFICATION — Spec does not define the exact empty cart message text. Expected: a message indicates the cart is empty and a Continue Shopping button is visible.

Title: Cart persists across pages during the same browser session
Preconditions: User has added at least one item to the cart.
Steps: 1. Add a product to the cart. 2. Navigate to several other pages (homepage, products page, contact page). 3. Return to the cart page.
Expected Result: All previously added items are still present in the cart with correct quantities and totals.

Title: Cart icon in navigation header is accessible from all pages
Preconditions: User has at least one item in the cart.
Steps: 1. Navigate to the homepage. 2. Observe the navigation header. 3. Navigate to the Products page. 4. Observe the navigation header. 5. Navigate to the Contact page. 6. Observe the navigation header.
Expected Result: Cart icon is visible in the navigation header on every page. Cart icon reflects the current item count.

Title: Attempt to add more than 100 units of a single product to cart
Preconditions: User is on a product detail page.
Steps: 1. Enter 101 in the quantity field on the product detail page. 2. Click Add to Cart.
Expected Result: PENDING PM CLARIFICATION — Spec does not define the error message or behavior when quantity exceeds 100. Expected: system prevents adding more than 100 units and displays an appropriate message.

Title: Out of stock product added to cart displays warning when stock status changes
Preconditions: User has a product in their cart. The product's stock status changes to out of stock after being added.
Steps: 1. Add a product to the cart. 2. Simulate the product going out of stock (or verify with a known out of stock product). 3. Navigate to the cart page.
Expected Result: PENDING PM CLARIFICATION — Spec does not define the exact warning message text or visual treatment for out of stock items in cart. Expected: out of stock item is flagged with a visible warning indicator.

Title: Integration — Guest user attempting to add to cart is not blocked but checkout requires login
Preconditions: User is not logged in.
Steps: 1. Navigate to the All Products page. 2. Add a product to the cart. 3. Proceed to checkout from the cart page.
Expected Result: Guest user can add items to cart without logging in. When attempting to proceed to checkout, user is redirected to the Login page.

Title: Integration — Cart item count in navigation updates correctly after adding products from catalog
Preconditions: User is on the All Products page. Cart is empty.
Steps: 1. Add one product to the cart from the listing page. 2. Observe the cart icon count in the navigation header. 3. Add a second product. 4. Observe the cart icon count again.
Expected Result: Cart icon count increments correctly after each product is added. Count reflects the total number of items in the cart.

Title: Integration — Logged in user cart persists after navigating away and returning
Preconditions: User is logged in. User has items in the cart.
Steps: 1. Add two products to the cart. 2. Log out of the account. 3. Log back in with the same credentials. 4. Navigate to the cart page.
Expected Result: PENDING PM CLARIFICATION — Spec states cart persists for the duration of the browser session but does not define behavior after logout and re-login. Expected: cart contents are either retained or cleared — behavior needs to be defined by PM.

Title: Smoke — Search respects active category filter (SMART-201)
Preconditions: User is on the All Products page.
Steps: 1. Click on Women category in the left sidebar. 2. Enter any valid search term in the search bar. 3. Click the Search button. 4. Observe the search results.
Expected Result: Search results contain only Women's products matching the search term. Products from other categories are not displayed.
